newsitem.title: USA: Rubin agrees with Japan goals on external surplus.
newsitem.headline: Rubin agrees with Japan goals on external surplus.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said on Wednesday he agreed with Japan's goal that sustained increases in external surpluses should be avoided. Rubin was responding to a question about the sharp increase in Japan's current account surplus for April.
"I don't think one month or one quarter means anything. I think ... the objective is right of avoiding sustained increases in external surpluses," he told reporters.
Rubin said the United States supported Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's stated objectives that Japan needs to pursue growth led by domestic demand.
Asked about the Nomura corporate payoff scandal, Rubin said that all financial systems from time to time have problems that are serious and need to be dealt with. He declined to comment further.
